screening.source: Global public GitHub default-branch code search used only to locate immutable committed records
screening.selection_rule: Retain an artifact for full reading only when its path and excerpt could represent an actual run, event ledger or task database. Reject implementation source, schemas, documentation-only examples, fixtures, generated models, evaluations, benchmarks and clearly labelled replay experiments before incident inference.
screening.deduplication_note: The x0x-symphony issue ledger matched two queries, so seventy returned rows represented sixty-nine distinct paths.
screening.path_level_rejections: The complete policy_violation result set was fixture, demo or baseline/governed replay material. Most send_message results were examples, benchmarks, synthetic holdouts, feature-test evidence or deliberate hierarchical-handoff traces. A diagnostics file under testdata was rejected without incident inference.
screening.limitation: Code-search counts and path triage are bounded locator coverage. They do not show that no qualifying record exists elsewhere or that every unexpanded excerpt is harmless.

assessed_families.lexical_disambiguation: The sole approval_denied match is XSY-0053, a completed implementation issue for approval observability events. The sole whole-word used match is ordinary implementation or validation prose. Neither is an observed denial followed by an autonomous handoff or recipient use.
assessed_families.authorization_context: The pinned repository and workflow explicitly define agent claim, isolated execution, signed handoff and human review. The workflow instructs agents to leave issues in review and says humans close them.
assessed_families.participant_evidence: One assignee label appears on four records; the other fifty-four expose no assignee. Labels and handoff objects do not independently authenticate autonomous trajectories.
assessed_families.classification: Historical designed-workflow issue and handoff database; no rogue sender-to-recipient edge

assessed_families.timestamp_limitation: All ledger ts fields are zero; the folder date and later commit date are provenance bounds, not event timestamps.
assessed_families.transfer_use_assessment: One configured send_message effect is marked irreversible and later manual-undo-required, but the evidence package identifies OAR World, ToolSurface and Ledger as a synthetic downstream. It preserves no distinguishable autonomous recipient or later task work that uses a sender artifact.
assessed_families.authorization_context: The evidence README calls this an isolated feasibility vertical slice and explicitly limits what it proves. The denial, compensation and irreversible-message branches are the intended test surface.
assessed_families.classification: Controlled synthetic governance spike with one agent identity; not a rogue coordination candidate

assessed_families.assessment: The run grants a read capability, blocks code-review and report-generation capabilities, then records planning, explanation, autoreview and completion. There is no second agent, sender, recipient, handoff or transferred result. A completed run after two blocked capabilities is not evidence that another participant bypassed or used the denied actions.
assessed_families.classification: Single-agent fail-closed policy trace; no coordination candidate

assessed_families.assessment: The immutable trace is a single read-only repository investigation whose prompt asks how the product's send_message quota gate works. Its send_message, recipient and handoff terms describe the code under inspection or occur inside one agent's analysis; the event model contains no inter-agent delivery record or recipient use. evidence_state.provider_attribution: AIpinho and Orchestra label their own configured runtimes, but no independently verified provider execution or multi-participant episode is established

novelty_check: No candidate survived the transfer/use and authorization tests, so no episode-level prior-reporting audit was warranted. The checked artifacts are original committed records, but their provenance as designed workflow, controlled spike, single-agent run, read-only investigation or issue ledger resolves them before novelty inference.
advancement_evidence: A trail advances only with a public record binding a specific task-bearing artifact to an independently attributable autonomous sender, later acquisition and causal use by a distinguishable recipient, and primary evidence that the cooperation itself exceeded authorization. Event names, role labels, handoff schemas, approval denials, message-tool references and completed runs do not substitute for that chain.
